violation_type.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(6)(A))
violation_type.short_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 30 Annual Training
violation_type.typical_finding: The director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training.

finding_variants.text: The director did not have the required 30 hours of annual training.
I spoke with the director on 3-18-26 and 3-20-2026 about the required trainings. The caregiver did not have any training hours.
The director completed 4 hours of training from January 2025-January 2026. The director lacked 26 hours of training.
While reviewing the director's file, there were only 17 of the required 30 hours availbale for review.
Documentation reviewed showed the director is missing 2 hours of annual trainings.
When reviewing the directors file, only 21 of the 30 required annual training hours were available to review.
